banker_outreach: Hi Yasmin, Louis Fontaine (NMLS: 2125039) with Rocket Mortgage (NMLS: 3030). What's your timeline for buying a home? Just let us know if we can run a soft credit check; no impact to your credit score. Happy to help!

nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and moving toward a purchase — the play calls for speed and a frictionless path to application, not re-selling. With a $5,227/mo P&I payment and a 6.5% conventional rate already on the table, the client has context; the job now is to remove friction and get them to the next step fast.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly — acknowledge their message without a generic opener or re-pitch
  - Reference their specific numbers back to them: 6.5% conventional, $5,227/mo P&I
  - Do not open with discovery questions they haven't asked for

- Move straight to the application / soft credit pull
  - Send the e-sign link or application URL in the same reply — one tap, zero friction
  - Frame it as the natural next step: 'To lock in your rate and get you moving on this purchase, here's the link to get started — takes about 10 minutes'

- Keep the message short and action-forward
  - One sentence of context, one sentence of next step, one link
  - Do not pile on rate comparisons, savings projections, or product education — they are already bought in

- If no immediate response, follow up once within the hour
  - Single short text: 'Just want to make sure you got the link — happy to jump on a quick call if easier'
  - Do not send multiple follow-ups or revert to a pitch sequence
